property_summary: For any admissible call (10 ether attached, timestamp strictly increasing), fallback drains the contract's entire balance if and only if block.number % 15 == 0; the mutant drains it exactly when block.number % 15 != 0, breaking the rule for multiples of 15.
change_summary: Change the payout condition from `block.number % 15 == 0` to `block.number % 15 != 0`, inverting when the transfer occurs.
